I've replied to Dana in their DM. Moss's notes have two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments at check-in. Support patched it that evening.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). The gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

There's no Moss notes folder under `members/`. Moss's notes are the public digests in the team folders, which Dana can read. Moss's other two North digests mention Quarrendon but don't give any ticket numbers. I also told Dana that the Central digests list #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those are for Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon.

I only read the public files and the channels Dana is in, and didn't use message search.
